recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white portrait of a man in a hoodie and trucker hat, positioned on the left third of the frame, looking back over his shoulder toward the viewer. The right side is dominated by clean white negative space containing textured, hand-drawn style typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject gaze directed toward the viewer creates a psychological connection.
The dark silhouette of the subject balances the heavy black lettering on the right.
The stark white background isolates both the subject and the text as primary focal points.
coreInvariants: Asymmetrical composition with subject on the left.
Distressed, charcoal-like texture on the primary text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left 40% of the frame, cropped at the mid-torso, appearing at a medium-close scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large distressed title text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves right to the primary title, then down to the secondary metadata in the bottom right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive white space on the right half provides breathing room and emphasizes the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and charcoal grays in the subject's clothing and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the skin and hoodie fabric folds.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the subject/text and the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Humanist sans-serif with irregular, organic strokes.
letterConstructionRules: Uneven stroke weights suggesting hand-applied ink or charcoal.
Rough, jittery edges with visible grain and splatter.
Inconsistent baseline for a raw, unpolished feel.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'F' has an elongated top bar.
The 'a' is a single-story construction with a heavy bowl.
The 'l' features a slight curve at the base.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing between a raw, textured display face and a clean, geometric secondary face.

preserve: Distressed texture of the main title
avoid: Clean, perfect fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, emotional tone of the portrait.
Provides the necessary grit and weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man wearing a dark hoodie and a trucker hat. He should be positioned on the left side of the frame, looking back over his shoulder toward the camera. The background must be pure, seamless white. The lighting should be soft but directional to emphasize the texture of the fabric.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, hand-drawn title in the center-right area using a distressed charcoal texture. Add a secondary, smaller metadata line in a clean, light gray sans-serif font in the bottom right corner with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the main title textured and irregular?
Is the subject positioned on the left with white space on the right?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the charcoal texture on the text
Vertical position of the text block
mustRedesign: Any specific logos on the hat
The specific facial features of the celebrity
The exact wording of the text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject.
Check that the white background is consistent and without artifacts.
Verify the 'charcoal' texture looks organic and not like a digital filter.
Confirm the bottom-right text is legible but subtle.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast monochromatic side-profile portrait with raw, textured display typography placed in the negative space for a modern, minimalist editorial look.
